title: 2026 Report on Employer Firms: 2025 Small Business Credit Survey
note: 6,525 employer-firm responses; weighted convenience sample, not Portland estimates. AI module optional (about 81% response). 42/36/22% financing outcomes among applicants; 46% AI use.
evidence_locations: Web sections Debt and credit demand; Use of artificial intelligence; About survey. PDF p. 28 for AI module caveat.
methodology_note: Nonrandom sample; self-reported outcomes; no causal effects.

title: Business tax filing and payment: gross-receipts exemption thresholds
geography: Portland / Multnomah / Metro, distinct tax jurisdictions
note: City gross-receipts threshold less than $50,000 before 2026, $75,000 in 2026, $100,000 from 2027. City/county exemption still requires filing.
methodology_note: Gross-receipts eligibility is distinct from taxable net-income base; not individualized tax advice.

title: Small Businesses Get Tax Cut: adopted city threshold change
note: Confirms the threshold changes were adopted before the Sep 30 evidence cutoff.
methodology_note: Policy announcement; not an impact evaluation.

title: Large Firms With at Least 20 Employees Biggest AI Users
note: BTOS AI use about 17–20%; revised question covers any business function. Not comparable to older goods/services-only question or Fed sample.
methodology_note: Different universe/question from SBCS; cannot interpret survey gap as a trend.
